svg.text: IS G0022 — OASIS eQTL signals stratified by rs671 LD
1000 Genomes EAS n=504 LD reference; Y: marginal QTL -log10(p), X: r² to ALDH2 rs671.
Plot includes only genome-build and allele-exact matched GWAS–OASIS SNPs with callable reference LD.

Gold line: high-LD reference threshold r²=0.8. Red dot: strongest QTL among SNPs with callable EAS reference LD.
JPT (n=104) sensitivity in accompanying TSV; it is a subset of EAS reference, not independent validation.
NOT colocalization: OASIS full tested cis variant coverage, in-study LD and variant effect direction remain incomplete.
